notes:
Auto-pause, fonts for your name, your own button colour and a System page

- Auto-pause: a phone's time stops when it leaves the WiFi and starts again
  when it's back. Choose 2 to 30 minutes, or off, on the Rates page.
- Customer page: pick a font and thickness for your name and a colour for
  the coin button. The time card shows the date too, and the logo has no
  glow.
- Settings > System: the vendo's software, operating system and hardware,
  with Copy details. It warns when the vendo's clock is off.
